facts.text: Keep your foil hat on, Graham. And nobody touches Bo's glasses of water, they're everywhere.
facts.why: Graham does not wear a foil hat. The kids wear the foil helmets, and Graham teases Morgan about them.
facts.fix: Foil hats on, kids. And nobody touches Bo's glasses of water, they're everywhere.

facts.why: The family's last supper of favourites is spaghetti and French toast, plus Graham and his mashed potatoes. Chicken parmigiana was not found.
facts.fix: Last supper spaghetti and French toast

vibe.verdict: The recipe box and Bo's water glasses are right on theme, but the foil hat note and the last meal dish miss the film.
missing: Bo's half full glasses of water used as the weapon
Spaghetti and French toast left uneaten at the last supper
Graham crying over a plate of mashed potatoes
The alien's fingers in Ray Reddy's pantry
ideas: Swap 'Last-meal chicken parmigiana' for 'Spaghetti and French toast, uneaten' to match the last supper.
Swap 'Pennsylvania farmhouse pot roast' note for 'Mashed potatoes Graham cries over'.
Swap 'Apple butter on warm buttermilk biscuits' for 'Pantry door fingers biscuit sticks' only if Josh wants a darker nod.
Swap the 'Bo's half-full cucumber mint spritzers' note for 'Pour them out. Or don't.'
